format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-settings-menu id="pop"><button slot="trigger" id="pop-trigger" type="button">Настройки</button><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items":[{"key":"theme","type":"choice","label":"Тема","icon":"contrast","value":"system","default":"system","options":[{"value":"system","label":"Как в системе","icon":"computer"},{"value":"light","label":"Светлая","icon":"light_mode"},{"value":"dark","label":"Тёмная","icon":"dark_mode"}]},{"key":"density","type":"choice","label":"Плотность","icon":"density_medium","value":"normal","default":"normal","options":[{"value":"compact","label":"Плотно"},{"value":"normal","label":"Обычно"},{"value":"loose","label":"Свободно"}]},{"type":"divider"},{"key":"notify","type":"boolean","label":"Уведомления","icon":"notifications","value":true,"default":true},{"key":"export","type":"action","label":"Экспорт","icon":"download"}]}</script></sf-settings-menu>

probes.title: closed, the popup panel is not shown and the trigger says it opens a dialog

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#pop'); const t = document.querySelector('#pop-trigger'); const p = m.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu'); return p && p.getClientRects().length === 0 && t.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'dialog' && t.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && t.getAttribute('aria-controls') === p.id; })()

probes.title: the trigger opens the panel as a named dialog in the top layer, focus on the first row
probes.covers: actions.open, events.open, events.opened, host-states data-open, layer.kind surface

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#pop'); const p = m.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu'); return p.matches(':popover-open') && p.getAttribute('role') === 'dialog' && p.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') && m.getAttribute('data-open') === 'true' && document.querySelector('#pop-trigger').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu-row--drill') && document.documentElement.dataset.sfPopoverOpen === '1'; })()

probes.title: a choice row opens its list in place: back head, listbox, the chosen option focused and selected
probes.covers: settings.items choice, host-states data-level, keyboard ArrowRight

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#pop'); const l = m.querySelector('[role=listbox]'); const a = document.activeElement; return m.getAttribute('data-level') === 'theme' && l && a.getAttribute('role') === 'option' && a.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true' && a.dataset.sfValue === 'system' && m.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu-back'); })()

probes.title: choosing an option asks, changes, goes back and focuses the row

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#pop'); return m.values.theme === 'light' && !m.hasAttribute('data-level') && document.activeElement.dataset.sfKey === 'theme' && document.activeElement.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu-row-value').textContent === 'Светлая'; })()

probes.title: ArrowLeft and Escape go back from a list before they close
Escape on the top level closes the panel and gives focus back to the trigger

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#pop-trigger'); return t.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && (document.activeElement === t || t.contains(document.activeElement)) && !document.querySelector('#pop').hasAttribute('data-open') && !document.documentElement.dataset.sfPopoverOpen; })()

probes.title: a switch toggles in its row without leaving the level

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#pop'); const i = m.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu-row--switch input'); return m.values.notify === false && i.checked === false && i.getAttribute('role') === 'switch' && m.hasAttribute('data-open'); })()

probes.title: a page that cancels the change keeps the value and the switch

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#pop'); return m.values.notify === true && m.querySelector('.sf-settings-menu-row--switch input').checked === true; })()

probes.title: a press outside (pointerdown on the page) closes the panel as outside
an action row asks the page to apply it and closes the popup
inline, the panel is a group always shown and open() is refused

steps.check: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#inl .sf-settings-menu'); return p.getAttribute('role') === 'group' && p.getClientRects().length > 0; })()

probes.title: reset puts the items with a default back and sends changed for each
